page.title: Commission
page.purpose: One commission's state with every source on tap, what changed, steering (Say, controls, courier), its start-up read and its files.

states.description: Status tab: facts with evidence, changes since last look, sessions and launch timeline.
An older charter does not read the operator file; Enable steering is offered with the exact line the API's dry run says it adds, or that it is already there.

Every control and Say entry is confirmed with exactly what will be typed or written and where; a Say entry shows the API's dry-run text and when the supervisor reads it (next unit, after resume, not until steering is enabled, or never), as a warning when it waits.
Agent Manager is down: session-derived values read unknown, controls are disabled with the reason.
The API cannot be reached or refused the read; the page names which and offers retry, and nothing else on the page pretends to know.
The page announces that it is reading the research home; nothing is shown as known until it is.
The commission folder holds only a packet: facts read unknown or none, and the launch steps are offered.
A refresh failed after a good read: the earlier read stays on screen under a 'Not current' notice with its time and the reason.
